values.name: Ground equipment
values.description: Ground equipment being fuelled or serviced.

values.name: Chain
values.description: Chain used in the securing of cargo.

values.name: Temperature recorder
values.description: Temperature recorder to provide a record of the actual temperature.

values.name: Body trailer
values.description: The part of the vehicle where the cargo is loaded.

values.name: Blocks
values.description: A piece of equipment that is normally a piece of wood to fix cargo (e.g. coils) during transport.

values.name: Box pallet EUR Y non exchangeable
Barge
values.description: Flat bottomed inland cargo vessel for canals and rivers with or without own propulsion for the purpose of transported goods. (Synonym: Lighter).

values.name: Boxcar
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Chassis
values.description: A wheeled carriage onto which an ocean container is mounted for inland conveyance.

values.name: Container
values.description: Equipment item as defined by ISO for transport. It must be of: A) permanent character, strong enough for repeated use; B) designed to facilitate the carriage of goods, by one or more modes of transport, without intermediate reloading; C) fitted with devices for its ready handling, particularly.

values.name: Load/unload device on equipment
values.description: A mechanical device used in the loading and/or unloading of cargo into and from transport equipment.

values.name: Pallet
values.description: A platform on which goods can be stacked in order to facilitate the movement by a forklift or sling.

values.name: Platform
values.description: A piece of equipment normally having a flat surface, or prepared for carrying cargo with a specific shape.

values.name: Flat car
values.description: Description to be provided.

values.name: Reefer generator
values.description: A generator used to control the temperature in temperature-controlled transport equipment.

values.name: Ground facility
values.description: Storage tank or facility capable of receiving shipment of goods or commodity.

values.name: Rope
values.description: Rope used in the securing of cargo.

values.name: Rail car
values.description: [8320] Registered identification number of railway wagon (CIM 19).

values.name: Swap body
values.description: Rectangular equipment unit without wheels, which can be mounted on a chassis or positioned on legs.

values.name: Trailer
values.description: A vehicle without motive power, designed for the carriage of cargo and to be towed by a motor vehicle.

values.name: Tarpaulin
values.description: Waterproof material, e.g. canvas, to spread over cargo to protect it from getting wet.

values.name: Tackles
values.description: [8030] Identification marks and numbers of loading tackle used (sheets, ropes, chains, etc..), as specified in DCU 9 to CIM Article 13; and of containers, as specified in Articles 5 and 10 of Annex III to CIM (CIM 17).

values.name: ULD (Unit load device)
values.description: An aircraft container or pallet.
